next.reason: Amendment X3.23b-1993 replaced the cross-reference to the deleted file-attribute-conflict paragraph with two sentences: 'The implementor defines which of the fixed file attributes are validated during the execution of the OPEN statement. The validation of fixed file attributes may vary depending on the organization and/or storage medium of the file' (§1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR6), after 'the execution of the OPEN statement is unsuccessful'. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10 carries all three sentences: 'a file attribute conflict condition occurs, the execution of the OPEN statement is unsuccessful ... The implementor defines which of the fixed-file attributes are validated during the execution of the OPEN statement. The validation of fixed-file attributes may vary depending on the organization or storage medium of the file'. Its status '39' is the 1985 value too (§1985:VII.1.3.5 'I-O Status = 39. The OPEN statement is unsuccessful because a conflict has been detected'), restated by §2023:9.1.13.6 GR7. Same unsuccessful OPEN, same implementor latitude.
